leadText: (Japanese: ポケモンバトルストーリーズ Pokémon Battle Stories) is a Pokémon manga created by Miho Asada. It is about the struggles of a girl named Wakaba, a reporter in charge of creating a book about Pokémon. She travels to various places to interview trainers.
plainText:
(Japanese: ポケモンバトルストーリーズ Pokémon Battle Stories) is a Pokémon manga created by Miho Asada. It is about the struggles of a girl named Wakaba, a reporter in charge of creating a book about Pokémon. She travels to various places to interview trainers.

==Publications==
Pokémon Battle Stories has only ever been published in its original magazine. It was serialized in Shogaku Ninensei over fourteen issues from April 2011 to May 2012.
